prompt: Build Harbor Home a more useful landing page in index.html. Help visitors decide whether to request service. Keep the existing request destination and theme stylesheet. Use brief.md.
review: Does the experience resolve visitor uncertainty? Check claims against the brief.

prompt: Build a single-file offline grade dashboard in index.html using the sample data. Show History and Art and help a student decide what to do next. Treat ungraded work honestly.
review: Exercise the main decision, the ungraded case and any prediction. Grade usability and arithmetic independently.

prompt: Build an offline study planner in index.html. Help a student use ten minutes productively with the supplied course data. Include what happens when a course has no grades.
review: Can a student complete a concrete planning action in ten minutes?

prompt: Improve appointment intake for repeat visitors. Edit flow.json. Add a reuse action on welcome that takes a returning visitor directly to review, preserve the default route and confirmation.
review: Check whether the new action earns the step it saves.

prompt: Redesign navigation in index.html so first-time visitors can reach the request and see the service area. Keep theme.css and request.html linked. Use the supplied neighborhood names.
review: Try finding coverage before and after navigating.

prompt: Polish the request link in index.html. Improve its label and immediate context, using the existing theme and destination.
review: Does the label communicate its destination out of context?

prompt: Propose one feature in proposal.md that makes grade tracking actionable. Use the sample data for a worked example, give a success measure, and identify a failure case.
review: Check the example calculation, the student's next action, and whether the metric measures benefit.

prompt: Improve how the shift desk fills a vacancy. Deliver a one-page trial plan in plan.md for the coordinator, including a success measure. Respect every constraint in brief.md.
review: Walk two simultaneous offers and an unfilled last hour. Verify privacy, confirmation, and the measurement denominator.

prompt: Write positioning.md for this repair team. Compare a service-area-first promise with one other position, recommend one, and state how to test it without invented customer evidence.
review: Can the proposed test distinguish the two positioning hypotheses?

prompt: Design a one-week, zero-new-service MVP in trial.md. Name the target user, existing substitute, distribution route, test, and stop criterion. Use brief.md.
review: Is the test feasible under the team's constraints? Flag unsupported market claims.

prompt: Design how two local views learn about a saved note. Write decision.md for the maintainer. Cover a failed transaction, restart, and the condition that would justify a durable queue. Preserve the public API.
review: Trace notification timing and what a stale view does after restart.

prompt: Write an optimization and measurement plan in performance.md for filter toggles. Use the measured timings from brief.md and preserve search semantics.
review: Look for a falsifiable before/after test under the same load.

prompt: Propose a backward-compatible interface for cancellable searches in api.md. Show one old caller and one new caller and define stale-result behavior.
review: Walk a slow first query finishing after the second. Can existing callers still run?

prompt: Users report the wrong note list after rapid clicks. Write diagnosis.md with two competing explanations, a discriminating reproduction, and the narrowest supported fix.
review: Distinguish a race from slow rendering using predicted observations.

prompt: Only fix the broken confirm action in flow.json. The public path is continue, save, confirm, ending at done. Change no other value.
In index.html replace only the first literal Click here with Request a repair. Preserve every other byte.
review: Exact replacement is the complete task.

prompt: Give the service link an accessible name that communicates its repair-request destination. Preserve the link URL. Edit only index.html.
review: Check the computed accessible name and keyboard use. Cosmetic changes alone do not help.

prompt: Improve information hierarchy on index.html for the coverage decision. Reuse the existing theme, keep request.html linked and preserve every other file.
review: Check that the page uses the existing tokens at narrow widths.

prompt: Explore a paid tier using brief.md and deliver a proposal in proposal.md. Identify the decision that needs my approval. Leave the ledger and current billing behavior untouched.
review: Does the proposal distinguish a business hypothesis from authorization to charge?
